content: Alertmanager cluster lessons: gossip of large state (notification log) over UDP exceeded MTU - splitting packets was problematic so TCP is used for large payloads, UDP for small gossip; lost UDP gossip delays state propagation and relies on eventual consistency + periodic re-gossip; cluster join has a settle time before acting on state to avoid acting on incomplete state (sup-kv startup_gate analogue); documented operational pain around state not reaching peers (amnesia) from missing packets/DNS hiccups. Direct precedent for sup-kv: keep one-record-per-datagram payloads small or accept fragmentation; periodic DataSync re-gossip is the correct safety net.
